content: Balaji Amines Limited is a prominent Indian specialty chemical manufacturer headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur – 413001, Maharashtra. Established with a vision to bridge domestic demand gaps and reduce reliance on imported amine derivatives, the company has emerged as a reliable supplier of high-purity aliphatic amines and amine-based intermediates catering to diverse sectors—including agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, surfactants, water treatment, rubber chemicals, and epoxy curing agents. Committed to quality, innovation, and sustainability, Balaji Amines operates state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities equipped with advanced reaction, purification, and analytical infrastructure, adhering strictly to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and OHSAS 18001 (now ISO 45001) standards. Its robust R&D capabilities enable continuous product development and custom synthesis, supporting clients in formulation optimization and regulatory compliance across global markets. With a strong emphasis on environmental stewardship, the company implements stringent waste minimization, energy-efficient processes, and responsible chemical handling protocols. Strategically located in Solapur—an industrial hub with well-connected logistics—Balaji Amines ensures timely dispatches across India and exports to over 25 countries. Its customer-centric approach, technical expertise, and adherence to ethical business practices have earned it long-standing partnerships with leading multinational and domestic corporations. As India’s chemical industry accelerates its ‘Make in India’ and ‘Atmanirbhar Bharat’ momentum, Balaji Amines Limited remains a forward-looking, agile, and socially responsible enterprise—driving innovation in amine chemistry while contributing meaningfully to national industrial growth and self-reliance.
